```{r setup}
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(powerjoin)
library(here)
library(synExtra)
library(DESeq2)
library(readxl)
library(ggrastr)
library(ggrepel)

conflicts_prefer(
  dplyr::filter,
  dplyr::count,
  generics::setdiff,
  dplyr::slice,
  dplyr::rename,
  purrr::reduce
)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica")
)

synapser::synLogin()
syn <- synDownloader(normalizePath("~/data"), .cache = TRUE)

plot_dir <- here(
  "2026-07-07_coralie_ngfr_rnaseq", "plots"
)
dir.create(
  plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE
)
```

## Loading data

```{r}
counts_raw <- syn("syn76375618") |>
  read_tsv()

gene_meta <- counts_raw |>
  distinct(gene_id, gene_name, gene_biotype)

meta_raw <- syn("syn76375613") |>
  read_excel(
    sheet = "Priority",
    skip = 1
  )
```

```{r}
counts_long <- counts_raw |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(gene_id, gene_name, gene_biotype),
    names_to = c("library_id", "sample_id", "count_type"),
    names_pattern = "^([^_]+)_([0-9]+)_(cpm|count)$",
    values_to = "count"
  )

count_mat <- counts_long |>
  filter(
    count_type == "count"
  ) |>
  select(gene_id, sample_id, count) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = sample_id,
    values_from = count
  ) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") |>
  as.matrix()

genes_eligible <- rownames(count_mat)[rowSums(count_mat > 3) > 3] |>
  str_subset("^ENSG")
```


## Count transformation

Have to use only letters in condition names, otherwise DESeq2 complains

```{r}
deseq_meta <- meta_raw |>
  filter(Sample %in% counts_long$sample_id) |>
  mutate(
    NGFRstatus = case_when(
      Group == "Acute" ~ "all",
      NGFRstatus == "NGFR+" ~ "NGFRpos",
      NGFRstatus == "NGFR-" ~ "NGFRneg",
      TRUE ~ NA
    ),
    condition = paste(
      Cell_line, Group, NGFRstatus, Treatment, sep = "_"
    )
  )

deseq_all <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, as.character(deseq_meta$Sample)] |>
    round(),
  colData = deseq_meta,
  design = ~ 1
) |>
  estimateSizeFactors() |>
  estimateDispersions()

counts_all <- bind_rows(
  raw = counts(deseq_all, normalized = FALSE) |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id"),
  norm = counts(deseq_all, normalized = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id"),
  vst = vst(deseq_all, blind = TRUE) |>
    assay() |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id"),
  .id = "count_type"
)
```

## PCA

```{r}
vst_mat <- counts_all |>
  filter(count_type == "vst") |>
  select(-count_type) |>
  column_to_rownames("gene_id") |>
  as.matrix()

pca_raw <- prcomp(t(vst_mat), scale. = FALSE, center = TRUE)

pca_x <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x, rownames = "sample_id_unique") |>
  power_inner_join(
    meta,
    by = c("sample_id_unique"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

pca_x_long <- as_tibble(pca_raw$x, rownames = "Sample") |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("PC"),
    names_to = "component",
    values_to = "value"
  )

pca_sd <- broom::tidy(pca_raw, "eigenvalues")

pc_sd_map <- with(
  pca_sd,
  set_names(percent, paste0("PC", PC))
)
```


```{r}
pca_x_vs <- combn(paste0("PC", seq_len(5)), 2) |>
  t() |>
  magrittr::set_colnames(paste0("component_", seq_len(2))) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  power_inner_join(
    pca_x_long,
    by = c("component_1" = "component"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn"
    )
  ) |>
  power_inner_join(
    pca_x_long,
    by = c("component_2" = "component", "Sample"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    ),
    suffix = c("_1", "_2")
  ) |>
  power_inner_join(
    deseq_meta |>
      mutate(
        across(Sample, as.character),
        across(
          Group,
          \(x) factor(x, levels = c("Acute", "SingleClone", "FACS"))
        ),
        across(
          NGFRstatus,
          \(x) factor(x, levels = c("-", "NGFR-", "NGFR+"))
        )
      ),
    by = c("Sample"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

p <- ggplot(
  pca_x_vs,
  aes(
    x = value_1,
    y = value_2,
    color = fct_cross(Group, NGFRstatus, sep = " | "),
    shape = Cell_line,
    size = Treatment
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_size_manual(
    values = c("DMSO" = 1, "Vemurafenib" = 2)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Acute | -" = "#444444",
      "SingleClone | NGFR-" = "#9ECAE1",
      "SingleClone | NGFR+" = "#2171B5",
      "FACS | NGFR-" = "#FCAE91",
      "FACS | NGFR+" = "#CB181D"
    ),
    name = "Group"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~paste0(component_1, " (", signif(pc_sd_map[component_1] * 100, 2), "%) vs ", component_2, " (", signif(pc_sd_map[component_2] * 100, 2), "%)"),
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  envalysis::theme_publish() +
  theme(
    legend.box = "vertical",
    strip.clip = "off"
  )
p

ggsave(
  file.path(
    plot_dir, "pca_vst_all_samples.pdf"
  ),
  p, width = 8, height = 8
)
```


## Differential expression

```{r}
extract_deseq_result <- function(de, contrast, name, res_args = list(), shrink_args = list()) {
  if (missing(contrast)) {
    res <- rlang::exec(results, de, name = name, !!!res_args)
  } else {
    res <- rlang::exec(results, de, contrast = contrast, !!!res_args)
  }
  if (!"type" %in% names(shrink_args)) {
    shrink_args$type <- "ashr"
  }
  shrunken <- rlang::exec(lfcShrink, de, res = res, !!!shrink_args)
  shrunken |>
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
    left_join(
      res |>
        as_tibble(rownames = "gene_id") |>
        select(gene_id, log2FoldChange, lfcSE),
      by = "gene_id", suffix = c("", "_MLE")
    )
}
```

```{r}
deseq_meta |> count(condition)

de_contrasts <- tribble(
  ~contrast_name, ~condition_numerator, ~condition_denominator,
  "Acute A375 Vemurafenib vs DMSO", "A375_Acute_all_Vemurafenib", "A375_Acute_all_DMSO",
  "FACS A375 NGFR+ vs NGFR-", "A375_FACS_NGFRpos_Vemurafenib", "A375_FACS_NGFRneg_Vemurafenib"
)

deseq_de <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = count_mat[genes_eligible, as.character(deseq_meta$Sample)] |>
    round(),
  colData = deseq_meta,
  design = ~ condition
) |>
  DESeq()

deseq_res <- de_contrasts |>
  mutate(
    res = map2(
      condition_numerator,
      condition_denominator,
      \(num, den) {
        extract_deseq_result(
          deseq_de,
          contrast = c("condition", num, den)
        )
      }
    )
  ) |>
  unnest(res) |>
  power_left_join(
    gene_meta,
    by = c("gene_id"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  ) |>
  select(starts_with("condition"), starts_with("gene"), everything()) |>
  mutate(
    gene_label = coalesce(gene_name, gene_id)
  )
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(
  deseq_res,
  aes(
    x = log2FoldChange,
    y = -log10(padj)
  )
) +
  rasterize(
    geom_point(
      aes(
        color = padj < .05
      ),
      shape = 16,
      alpha = .5
    ), dpi = 300, device = "ragg_png"
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(
      label = gene_label
    ),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    data = \(df) group_by(df, contrast_name, log2FoldChange > 0) |>
      arrange(padj, pvalue) |>
      slice_head(n = 10)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "red")
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~contrast_name,
    scales = "free"
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(
    plot_dir, "de_volcanos.pdf"
  ),
  p, width = 8, height = 5
)
```
